answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock an on-chain anchor stake that is irreversibly burned upon malicious coordination. We enforce a quadratic burning penalty scaled by node density: minting $N$ identities incurs a superlinear cost of $O(N^2)$ burned capital, imposing brutal economic friction. Any coordinated attack creates an uncontainable ripple of collateral slashing, locking adversary funds as securely as ferrous metal in solid rock.
